purpose: verification artifact for src/dataset/material_pricing.py: it proves the module reproduces its anchors and resolves dated prices from the pinned files. it is not a replacement for data/synthetic/v4/material_agents.csv, which this task does not touch

cotton.basis: Tabb Textile 2024 catalog. it prints no price date; its url is filed under uploads/2024/11, the earliest month the catalog is evidenced as published

denim.basis: Tabb Textile 2024 catalog, same basis as cotton

polyester.basis: Tabb Textile 2024 catalog, same basis as cotton. with no temporal series the anchor date does not change the price

linen.basis: iMaterial 'January 2024 Fabric Pricelist', the first day of the edition month

leather.basis: the Leather Unlimited product page carries no price date; the access date recorded on the manual record is used

choices_made_here.leather_oz_per_sqft: midpoint of the 2-3 oz range the product is sold as

materials_without_a_temporal_series.polyester: fixed at its Tabb Textile finished-fabric anchor, because its SunSirs observations are missing (methodology section 5.1)
